records.title: Review explanations emit detached JSON-safe coefficient snapshots without mutating policy lineage
adjudication_notes: The existing Tier A review explanation family was extended before source repair to prove resolved coefficient outputs are detached JSON-safe snapshots rather than live Pydantic model references.
The targeted proof passed without source repair because ReviewExplanationService already emits coefficient.model_dump() snapshots and copies lineage lists.
